project_type: npm monorepo (no root workspace): backend/ Fastify 5 + @fastify/websocket + Postgres (snapshot-backed live rooms); frontend/ Next.js 16.3.5 + React 19 + zustand
language: TypeScript (backend ESM with .js import suffixes; frontend tsx; frontend tests are .mjs)
build_system: backend: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json; frontend: next build. Windows PowerShell; no root package.json.
test_framework: backend: vitest (backend/tests/*.test.ts, helper tests/helpers.ts fixture(), FakeLiveSql in tests/helpers-pg-double.ts); frontend: headless Playwright+esbuild .mjs scripts in frontend/tests (pattern recall-ui.mjs, ui-harness.mjs), run with node
build_command: cd backend; npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit  |  cd frontend; npm run build (once, at the end)
test_command: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/live-add-players.test.ts (then full npx vitest run)  |  cd frontend; node tests/pool-import-ui.mjs; node tests/pool-import-store.mjs; node tests/type-boundary.mjs
verification_instructions: See plan.md section 3 per-item Verify lines. Baseline: backend 56 tests pass for recall/fc26-import/auction; npx tsc --noEmit has ONE pre-existing error (tests/helpers-pg-double.ts(15,5)); earlier report says 6 skip-vote baseline vitest failures plus load timeouts; frontend recall-ui.mjs and type-boundary.mjs pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Do not commit test-results/ PDF churn. No migration is needed (state is jsonb in live_room_snapshots); never apply migrations to any DB.
environment_constraints: Never run against the hosted DB; no long-lived dev servers; Windows paths contain a space ("Realtime -Auction") so always quote; do not push; do not revert or delete untracked .agents/tasks/continue-rejoin-auction/*. frontend/AGENTS.md: read frontend/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before Next.js code (only page.tsx wiring is touched).
contribution_requirements: Follow existing compact code style; no unrequested refactors; server computes prices; host-only via requireHost; update backend/WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md; commit locally with conventional commits.
key_patterns: All room writes via RoomManager.mutate (lock + latest clone + optimistic sequence + events). Events are UPPER_SNAKE and the hub follows each event with a full per-viewer ROOM_STATE. Host commands live in auction.schemas.ts + auction.engine.ts switch (see RECALL_PLAYERS). Frontend: parseServerEvent whitelists event names; mapPlayer in services/contract.ts; UnderdogTag.tsx hosts small badges; Modal/Button/ConfirmDialog in components/ui.
